answer: A nadir of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
